blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing event-based tracking methods typically operate in an online manner, associating tracklets across adjacent batches. However, this limited temporal window often leads to failures in challenging scenarios, such as long-term occlusions or missed detections, where broader temporal context should be incorporated for high-precision tracking. To achieve robust and accurate tracking, this paper concentrates on the event-based multi-dimensional assignment that associates tracklets across multiple batches simultaneously. Unlike image-based detectors, event-based detectors can generate multiple correct yet spatially distinct tracklets for a single object per batch. This violates the one-to-one rule in classic data association, making event-based association an underdetermined many-to-many matching problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to tackle this NP-hard problem. To address its underdetermined nature, we formulate the assignment problem via fuzzy logic, where pairwise tracklet correlations are quantified through multiple long-range kinematic metrics. This fuzzy design eliminates the need for hard tracking thresholds and enables multiple heterogeneous metrics to be integrated into a unified correlation. By treating tracklets as nodes and their fuzzy correlations as edges, we construct a Hierarchical Sparse Graph (HSG). Building upon the HSG, we pose assignment as a graph partition task, and employ a heuristic solution that measures vertex affinity for partitioning adaptively. The entire pipeline is training-free. Comprehensive experiments on two challenging event datasets, eTram and Ev-UAV, show that our method outperforms existing event-based and most image-based association models. Particularly, it achieves over 2$\times$ the performance of OC-SORT across all metrics in the many-to-many association scenario.
blocks.zh: 现有的基于事件的跟踪方法一般以在线方式运行,将相邻批次的跟踪轨道连接起来. 然而,这种有限的时间窗口往往导致在具有挑战性的情景中出现失败,例如长期隔离或检测缺失,而对于高精度跟踪,应当纳入更广泛的时间背景。 为了实现稳健而准确的跟踪,本文集中论述基于事件的多维任务,该任务同时连接多批次的跟踪. 与以图像为基础的探测器不同,以事件为基础的探测器可以为每批单个物体产生多条正确而空间上独立的轨道. 这违反了经典数据关联中的一对一规则,使得事件关联成为未确定的许多比对问题. 据我们所知,这是处理这一核问题的第一个工作。 为了解决其确定性不足的问题,我们通过模糊的逻辑来提出分配问题,通过多种远距离运动测量法,将对等轨道的关联量化。 这种模糊的设计消除了硬追踪阈值的需要并使得多种不同度量标准能够被整合到一种统一的关联中去. 通过将轨迹作为节点和模糊的相通性作为边缘,我们构建了分级分层图(HSG). 在卫生与安全小组的基础上,我们把任务定位为图分任务,并采用一个高压解决方案,以适应性的方式衡量顶点的亲和性。 整个管道都是免费的 eTram和Ev-UAV这两个具有挑战性的事件数据集的全面实验显示,我们的方法优于现有的基于事件和大多数以图像为基础的关联模型。 特别是,它实现了OC-SORT在众多关联情景中所有度量标准上的性能超过2美元\%.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Data assignment is a critical step in Multiple Object Tracking (MOT) [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] , especially in the tracking-by-detection paradigm. It is a classic combinatorial optimization problem aimed at identifying matching pairs among detections (or tracklets). Depending on the number of frames considered, image-based data association can be roughly categorized into two types: linear assignment for online tracking and multi-dimensional assignment for offline tracking. Although linear assignment methods [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] have shown strong performance, certain challenges, such as long-term occlusions or missed detections [ 8 , 9 ] , can lead to a performance drop. To address this problem, a few works [ 10 , 11 ] incorporate multiple frames into the association process. These approaches are termed multi-dimensional assignment.
blocks.zh: 数据分配是多物体跟踪(MOT)[1,2,3,4]中的关键一步,特别是在逐项跟踪检测范式中. 这是一个典型的组合优化问题,目的是在检测(或跟踪)中识别匹配的对子. 根据考虑的框架数量,基于图像的数据关联可以大致分为两类:在线跟踪的线性任务和离线跟踪的多维任务. 虽然线性指派方法[5,6,7]表现出强烈的性能,但某些挑战,如长期隔离或漏测[8,9],可能导致性能下降. 为了解决这一问题,一些工作[10、11]将多个框架纳入联系进程。 这些方法被称为多维任务。

blocks.en:
Event cameras are a notable class of bio-inspired sensors that work differently from conventional image-based cameras. Rather than outputting images at a fixed rate, they asynchronously capture per-pixel brightness changes as a stream of binary events. This unique working principle offers distinctive properties compared to image-based cameras, including high temporal resolution (1 μ ​ s \mu\text{s} ), high dynamic range ( > > 120 dB), and high sensitivity to dynamic stimuli [ 15 , 16 ] . These characteristics make event cameras particularly suitable for object tracking [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] in challenging conditions, like fast motion, extreme illumination, or low-texture targets, where image-based cameras often fail.
In such scenarios, achieving high tracking accuracy and robust performance becomes the priority. This motivates a rethinking of the prevailing event-based efficiency-oriented tracking design and calls for more accurate event-based tracking approaches.
blocks.zh:
事件摄像头是一类引人注目的生物启发传感器,与传统图像摄像头不同。 它们不是以固定的速度输出图像,而是同步捕捉作为二进制事件的流的每个像素亮度变化. 这个独特的工作原理与基于图像的相机相比提供了独特的特性,包括高时间分辨率(1μ s\mu\text{s}),高动态范围( > > 120 dB),以及对动态刺激的高度敏感性[15,16]. 这些特性使得事件摄像头特别适合在具有挑战性的条件下进行物体跟踪[17,18,19],如快速运动,极端照明,或低纹度目标,以图像为基础的摄像头经常失败.
在这种情况下,实现高跟踪准确度和稳健业绩成为优先事项。 这促使人们重新思考目前以事件为基础的注重效率的跟踪设计,并要求采用更准确的事件跟踪方法。

blocks.en:
Event-based association is a critical tracking component but has received limited attention. In this paper, we study event-based multi-dimensional assignment to improve the overall tracking performance.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a) and (b), upstream detections lead to two distinct association scenarios. The former resembles image-based association, where each object corresponds to exactly one detection per batch. We refer to this as one-to-one association. But for the other scenario, this one-to-one characteristic does not hold since asynchronous events can yield multiple spatially distinct yet valid detections for a single object. While image-based detectors can also produce multiple detections per object, this matching ambiguity can be eliminated via Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) or other strategies. In event-based vision, multiple detections for an object can all be correct and cannot be suppressed, as they may be different temporal segments of the event trajectory. In this case, event-based association becomes an underdetermined many-to-many matching problem. As the association period increases, the processing difficulty grows substantially.
blocks.zh:
基于事件的协会是一个关键的追踪部分,但受到的关注有限。 在本文中,我们研究基于事件的多维任务,以提高总体跟踪性能.
如图1(a)和(b)所示,上游探测导致两种不同的关联情景。 前者类似于基于图像的关联,每个对象对应于每批精确的一次检测. 我们将此称为一对一协会。 但对于另一种情况来说,这种一对一的特性并不具备,因为同步事件可以产生多个空间上截然不同但有效的单个物体探测. 虽然基于图像的探测器也可以产生每个物体的多个探测器,但这种匹配的模糊度可以通过Non-Maxim Present(NMS)或其他策略消除. 在以事件为基础的视觉中,对一个物体的多重探测都能够正确,无法压制,因为它们可能是事件轨迹的不同时间段. 在这种情况下,基于事件的关联成为一个未确定的许多比对问题. 随着联系期的延长,处理困难大大增加.

blocks.en: Unlike the one-to-one bipartite matching with binary outcomes, event-based association is an inherently fuzzy problem due to the non-unique correspondence between objects and tracklets. Therefore, we construct a fuzzy modeling pipeline that takes two motion-based metrics as input and yields a fuzzy correlation value in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] as output. Since no explicit mathematical mapping exists between these inputs and the output, we develop a hierarchical quantization method to bridge them, and subsequently propose a heuristic solution to seek the optimal assignment. The overall framework is shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 与一对一双体匹配二进制结果不同,事件关联由于对象和轨道之间的非独特对应关系,是一个固有的模糊问题. 因此,我们建造了一个模糊的模型管道,采用两个基于运动的度量法作为输入,并在[0, 1] [0,1]中得出模糊的相关值作为输出. 由于这些投入和输出之间没有明确的数学映射,我们开发了一种层次化的量化方法来连接它们,随后又提出了一个求得最佳分配的热力学解决方案. 总体框架见图2。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Flowchart of the event-based multi-dimensional assignment optimization. Batches of tracklets from event-based detectors are fed into the fuzzy modeling pipeline. Positional and directional affinities are first computed to evaluate pairwise tracklet relationships. These metrics are integrated via hierarchical and sparse quantization to produce unified correlations, based on which the HSG is constructed. Finally, graph partition is performed on the HSG to identify cohesive partitions as optimal assignments.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:基于事件的多维任务优化流程图. 来自事件探测器的铁轨被装入模糊模型管道。 位置和方向的亲和性首先被计算出来,以评价双向轨道关系。 这些度量衡是通过分级和稀疏的量化来整合的,以产生统一的关联关系,而HSG就是以此为基础构建的. 最后,在卫生与安全小组上进行图表分区,以将团结分区确定为最佳任务。

blocks.en:
The assignment problem is underdetermined, so we design a heuristic search-merge approach to find the optimal solution, which iteratively groups tracklets into cohesive partitions of HSG. Each partition corresponds to a set of tracklets of the same object. Central to this approach is a connection similarity measure, which leverages topological and weight information to assess the vertex affinity for merging. As this measure depends on multiple factors, manually setting a merging threshold is impractical. We derive an adaptive threshold under a null model to make the whole optimization automatic.
Our method is evaluated by comparing with multiple event-based and image-based association methods on eTram [ 13 ] and Ev-UAV [ 14 ] datasets for the above two association cases.
Contributions are summarized as follows: • This is the first work on event-based multi-dimensional assignment. We model the problem via fuzzy logic to integrate multiple kinematic metrics into unified tracklet correlations and construct a HSG for assignment optimization. • To model unpredictable and non-linear long-range event trajectories, we devise two kinematic metrics, Bézier curve-based position smoothness and direction-displacement-based variation consistency. These metrics capture the spatio-temporal coherence of tracklets in positional and directional domains, respectively. • A hyperparameter-free graph partition solution is proposed. It quantifies vertex affinities and partitions the graph adaptively for optimal assignment. • Despite being training-free, our method consistently outperforms existing event-based and motion-based methods, while remaining competitive with leading image-based association networks. Notably, it also demonstrates robust performance in tracking tiny objects (6.8 × \times 5.4 pixels) under large spatio-temporal gaps, surpassing OC-SORT [ 7 ] by over 2 × \times across all metrics.
blocks.zh:
分配问题没有被确定,所以我们设计了一种热力搜索-综合方法来寻找最佳解决方案,它迭代地将轨道组合成HSG的一致分区. 每个分区对应的是同一对象的一组轨道. 这种方法的核心是连接相似度测量,利用地形和重量信息评估顶点的亲和性进行合并。 由于这一措施取决于多种因素,人工设定合并门槛是不切实际的. 我们从一个无效的模型中得出一个适应性阈值,使整个优化自动化.
我们的方法是通过比较eTram[13]和Ev-UAV[14]上上述两个关联案例的多个事件和图像关联方法来评估的.

blocks.en: II Related works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
To date, event-based multi-dimensional assignment remains largely unexplored.
Existing event-based tracking methods often associate detections from adjacent batches or continuous timestamps for efficiency. Accordingly, we review both event-based association methods and relevant image-based multi-dimensional assignment techniques.
blocks.zh:
迄今为止,基于事件的多维任务基本上仍未得到探讨。
现有的基于事件的跟踪方法往往将来自相邻批次的检测或连续的时间戳联系起来,以提高效率. 因此,我们审查基于事件的联系方法和相关的基于图像的多维分配技术。

blocks.en: II-A Event-based association
blocks.zh: II-A 基于活动的协会

blocks.en:
Existing event-based association methods can be broadly grouped into two paradigms, direct association and tracking-by-detection. Direct association methods [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] usually assign individual events to existing clusters, which is a unique paradigm benefiting from asynchronously triggered events. Tracking-by-detection is the classic paradigm in the image-based tracking domain. Therefore, most existing event-based association methods are derived from the image-based counterparts.
These methods typically employ Kalman Filter with the Hungarian algorithm [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ] , neighbor searching [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] , or Intersection over Union (IoU)-based matching [ 32 , 33 ] . For instance, Alzugaray et al. [ 29 ] use a multi-hypothesis framework where the alignment score of each hypothesis is updated incrementally to track features in adjacent batches.
Hu et al. [ 30 ] generate head and tail descriptors from each tracklet, then match head descriptors of the previous batch with tail descriptors of the current batch.
Jiang et al. [ 24 ] use an offline-trained detector and an online-trained
tracker, where a Kalman fusion scheme has been proposed to incorporate measurements from the detector and the tracker for real-time intervention-free operations.
Barranco et al. [ 26 ] utilize Mean Shift to cluster event tracklets in X-Y-T space and employ Kalman Filter with Hungarian algorithm to associate them in adjacent batches.
Chen et al. [ 32 ] detect objects by bounding boxes in event frames and use IoU to evaluate association candidates. Despite their diversity in implementation, all these methods operate on adjacent batches, making them unable to associate fragmented tracklets with large spatio-temporal gaps.

现有的基于事件的关联方法可以大致分为两个范式,即直接关联和逐一跟踪. 直接关联方法 [20, 21, 22] 通常将单个事件指定给现有的集群,这是一种从同步触发的事件中受益的独特范例. 逐一跟踪是基于图像的跟踪域中的经典范例. 因此,大多数现有的基于事件的联系方法来自基于图像的对应方.
这些方法通常使用Kalman Filter 与匈牙利算法 [23, 24, 25, 26] , 邻居搜索 [27, 28, 29, 30, 31] , 或 Intersection over Union (IoU) 基于匹配 [32, 33]. 例如,Alzugaray等人案。 [29] 使用一个多假说框架,其中每个假说对齐分数递增更新,以跟踪相邻批次中的特征.

追踪器,其中提出了卡尔曼聚变计划,将探测器和追踪器的测量纳入实时无干预操作.

blocks.en: II-B Image-based multi-dimensional assignment
blocks.zh: II-B 基于图像的多维任务

blocks.en: A fundamental constraint in image-based association is the one-to-one constraint. It states that each object must correspond to exactly one detection and one detection must belong to only one object. This results in a bijective mapping between detections and objects. In image-based multi-dimensional assignment, although the increasing number of candidates elevates the complexity of the problem, this constraint renders this NP-hard problem well-posed.
blocks.zh: 基于形象的关联的一个基本制约因素是一对一的制约。 它指出,每个物体必须完全对应一个探测器,一个探测器必须只属于一个物体. 这导致了探测器和物体之间的双射图. 在基于图像的多维派任中,尽管越来越多的候选人提高了问题的复杂性,但这一制约因素使这一NP难题得到很好的处理。

blocks.en:
Some works have formulated multi-dimensional assignments as a network flow problem [ 34 , 8 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] , with nodes as detections and edge weights based on appearance or motion.
Butt et al. [ 10 ] treat tracking as a binary linear program and apply Lagrangian Relaxation to decompose the assignment into a series of simpler min-cost network flow subproblems.
Collins et al. [ 36 ] break the problem into several two-frame linear assignments solved with the Hungarian algorithm. While these approaches yield good results, some works explore diverse modeling methods for the multi-dimensional assignment problem.
Poschmann et al. [ 37 ] avoid explicit data association. They model association as a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) within a factor graph.
Ochs et al. [ 11 ] build a hypergraph and use spectral clustering to obtain trajectories.
Roshan et al. [ 38 ] formulate data association as a Generalized Minimum Clique Problem (GMCP) on a graph. This method addresses one object’s data association at a time and employs Tabu Search to find the clique that minimizes a global cost combining appearance similarity and motion consistency iteratively.
Based on this work, Dehghan et al. [ 39 ] model a Generalized Maximum Multi Clique Problem (GMMCP) and use Binary Integer Programming (BIP) to find K-cliques that maximize the sum of edge weights with dummy nodes to handle occlusions.

blocks.en: While image-based methods work for the one-to-one association, they still fail in the many-to-many association. Besides, these methods typically utilize appearance cues for association, but such information is largely unavailable in events. We therefore rethink the modeling of event-based multi-dimensional assignment and leverage only kinematic features to capture relationships between tracklet pairs.
blocks.zh: 虽然基于形象的方法对一对一的协会有效,但在多对多的协会中仍然失败. 此外,这些方法通常利用外表提示进行联系,但在事件中基本上得不到这种信息。 因此,我们重新思考基于事件的多维分配的模型,并且利用只有运动特性来捕捉轨道对子之间的关系.

blocks.en: III-B Bézier curve-based Position Smoothness
blocks.zh: III-B 基于贝塞尔曲线的位置平滑度

blocks.en: Straight line motion is a common and effective assumption in event-based vision [ 40 , 23 ] , but it only holds over short time intervals. Over long durations, object trajectories often exhibit complex patterns due to unpredictable acceleration. To effectively associate long-range tracklets, we additionally introduce a position smoothness metric based on Bézier curves.
blocks.zh: 直线运动是事件视星等[40,23]中常见的有效假设,但只维持较短的时间间隔. 在很长的时间里,由于无法预测的加速,物体的轨迹往往表现出复杂的规律. 为了有效地连接长距离轨道,我们额外采用了基于贝塞尔曲线的位置平滑度测量.

blocks.en:
Bézier curve [ 41 , 42 ] is a flexible polynomial representation capable of expressing complex curves with relatively few control points. The expressive power of a Bézier curve depends on its order, i.e., the number of control points. Higher-order curves can fit complex trajectories more accurately. However, they do not always improve matching reliability, since they tend to overfit the data with overly intricate curvature.
A comparison between the quadratic and cubic Bézier curve fitting, as shown in Fig. 3 , illustrates this problem. For quantitative results, please refer to Sec. V-F . Though the cubic Bézier curve fits trajectory as accurately as the quadratic one, it also fits incorrect matching pairs well. This overfitting risk is further amplified by the high temporal resolution of event cameras, which provide finer-grained temporal units for curve evolution.
Consequently, we adopt the quadratic Bézier curve as the position fitting polynomial. As in Eq. 2 , the curve has three control points, P 0 P_{0} , P 1 P_{1} , and P 2 P_{2} . The independent variable t t describes the progression of curve generation.

Similarly, our line-based error considers only positional changes. To further constrain tracklets of the same trajectory, we introduce a second cue for continuous motion: velocity consistency.

The computation of two aforementioned metrics starts from temporally proximal candidates to distant ones. By representing tracklets as nodes and metric values as edge weights, we obtain two intermediate fully connected graphs (FCGs), one for each metric, as shown in Fig. 5 .
However, the high temporal resolution of events introduces two challenges during computation. First, E p E_{p} becomes unreliable as temporal intervals increase. blocks.en: Temporal scaling is a common strategy in event processing, typically implemented as exponential decay [ 43 ] to compress the temporal dimension. This strategy also balances the disparity in temporal and spatial scales, thereby helping to mitigate the second issue. However, it is not effective for the first one. Temporal scaling essentially samples the event stream along the t-axis. When a large scaling factor s s is applied, tracklets may degrade into points, further amplifying the first problem. To address it, we introduce a temporal weight factor λ > 1 \lambda>1 to E p E_{p} to adjust the association reliability with temporal intervals.

blocks.en: III-E Temporal Weight Analysis
blocks.zh: 三、时间重量分析

blocks.en: λ \lambda is introduced to reduce erroneous associations across large temporal gaps when computing positional error E p E_{p} . Theoretically, tracklets should be primarily associated with their temporal proximate neighbors. Only in the absence of such neighbors should the association be relaxed to include more temporally distant candidates. This association principle involves two factors, association interval Δ ​ t \Delta t and the historical match count α \alpha . Δ ​ t \Delta t denotes the temporal gap between tracklets, which is an intuitive indicator of association reliability. If two tracklets are temporally distant, they are less likely to be associated. α \alpha reflects the number of times a tracklet has been successfully associated in the past. In our framework, E p E_{p} computation proceeds from temporally proximal candidate pairs to more distant ones. For a tracklet with a high historical match count, further associations with remaining candidates should be treated with caution. Conversely, when a tracklet has low α \alpha , its association reliability should remain high even as Δ ​ t \Delta t increases, allowing it to connect with more candidates and recover from fragmentation.

Our optimization problem is an underdetermined combinatorial problem with no closed-form solution. Inspired by community detection in social network analysis [ 44 , 45 ] , we adopt a heuristic search-merge solution.
Based on the topological structure and edge weights within HSG, we design a connection similarity with an adaptive threshold to automatically guide the vertex merging for graph partitioning.

blocks.en: Edge weights in the HSG denote correlation strengths, allowing disconnected subgraphs to serve as initial partitions, as shown in Fig. 2 . Hence, graph partition is performed independently on each subgraph, which reduces the computational burden compared to performing it on the full graph.
blocks.zh: HSG中的边缘权重表示相关性强,允许断开的子图作为初始分区,如Fig所示. 2 (英语). 因此,图分区在每个子图上独立执行,这比在全图上执行减少计算负担.

blocks.en:
This solution operates through an iterative two-stage process of search and merge. Initially, each node is treated as a singleton vertex. In the search stage, connection similarities are evaluated between neighboring vertex pairs. Any pair satisfying the merging criterion is assigned a common label. This continues until all vertices are examined. In the subsequent merge stage, vertices sharing the same label are integrated into a new vertex. A new graph is reconstructed with updated vertex set. The entire procedure repeats until no mergeable vertices remain, and the final vertex set is the optimal partitioning result.
A summary of the procedure is provided in Algorithm 2 .

这个解决方案通过一个迭代的两阶段搜索和合并的过程运行. 最初,每个节点都作为单顿顶点处理. 在搜索阶段,相邻的顶点对之间评价连接相似性. 符合合并标准的任何一对均被指定一个共同的标签。 这一直持续到所有顶点检查. 在随后的合并阶段,共享相同标签的顶点被整合到一个新的顶点中. 用更新的顶点设置重建一个新的图表。 整个程序重复直到没有可合并的顶点留下,最终的顶点设置是最佳的分割结果.

blocks.en: V Experiments
blocks.zh: V 实验

blocks.en:
This section evaluates the effectiveness of our method for event-based association.
We conduct experiments on eTram [ 13 ] and Ev-UAV [ 14 ] . eTram is a novel event-based traffic perception dataset for MOT. It is curated using high spatial resolution ( 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 ) event cameras across challenging lighting conditions, with object sizes ranging from approximately 8 × 8 8\times 8 to 200 × 200 200\times 200 pixels. Ev-UAV is the first event-based tiny object detection dataset, which contains tiny targets with an average size of 6.8 × 5.4 6.8\times 5.4 pixels and provides event-wise labels. It covers challenging scenarios like high-brightness and low-light conditions.
blocks.zh:
本节评价我们基于事件的联系方法的有效性。
我们在eTram[13]和Ev-UAV[14]上进行实验. eTram是 MOT 的一个基于新事物的流量感知数据集. 它使用高空间分辨率(1280×720 1280\times 720)事件摄像头进行校准,跨越具有挑战性的照明条件,物体大小从大约8×8 8\times 8到200×200\times 200像素不等. Ev-UAV是第一个基于事件的微小物体检测数据集,它包含了平均大小为6.8×5.4 6.8\times 5.4像素的微小目标,并提供了事件导向的标签. 它涵盖了高亮度和低光度等具有挑战性的情景.

blocks.en:
On eTram, where the association scenario often resembles the image-based one-to-one matching, we compare our method against both event-based and image-based association methods under various detectors.
In contrast, the association on the Ev-UAV is many-to-many. We evaluate our method’s ability to solve this underdetermined problem and to achieve robust tracking of tiny objects.
Finally, we conduct ablation studies and sensitivity experiments to assess the contribution of key components and the robustness of our method under various parameter configurations. Detailed parameter experiments and analyses are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
在eTram上,关联情景往往类似基于图像的一对一匹配,我们比较了我们的方法与基于事件和图像的关联方法在各种探测器下.
相比之下,在Ev-UAV上的协会是众多的. 我们评价我们的方法是否有能力解决这个未确定的问题,并实现微小物体的有力追踪。
最后,我们进行消化研究和敏感度实验,以评估关键部件的贡献以及我们的方法在各种参数配置下的稳健性. 补充材料中提供了详细的参数实验和分析。

blocks.zh: 五-A 评价指标和模式配置

blocks.en:
On eTram, we employ MT (Mostly Tracked), ML (Mostly Lost), MOTA [ 47 ] (Multiple Object Tracking Accuracy), and IDF1 (Identification F-Score) [ 48 ] . For completeness, we also report the detection F1 score which is related to MOTA.
On Ev-UAV, we still report the IDF1, while adopting the evaluation metrics from its original work [ 14 ] , IoU and Acc (Accuracy). To assess tracking performance, we extend them to identity-aware versions by matching predicted identities with GT identities, referred to as Track IoU and Track Acc.

在eTram上,我们使用MT(最跟踪)、ML(最丢失)、MOTA[47](多对象跟踪精确度)和FDF1(识别F-Score)[48]。 为了完整起见,我们还报告与MOTA有关的检测F1分数。
关于Ev-UAV,我们仍然报告以色列国防军1号,同时采用其原始工作[14]、IoU和Acc(准确性)的评价指标。 为了评估跟踪性能,我们通过将预测身份与GT身份相匹配,将其扩展至了解身份的版本,称为Track IoU和Track Acc.

blocks.en: V-B Comparison methods
blocks.zh: V-B 比较方法

blocks.en: Event-based association methods. To the best of our knowledge, existing event-based tracking methods operate in an online manner and lack dedicated multi-dimensional assignment methods. To demonstrate the performance improvement enabled by our method, we compare it against three prevailing event-based association methods: (1) Kalman Filter (KF) with Hungarian algorithm (HA) [ 26 , 49 , 50 , 51 ] , (2) neighbor searching (NS) [ 52 , 30 , 29 , 53 ] , and (3) IoU-based matching [ 32 , 33 ] . Besides these, we also compare with two event-based single object tracking (SOT) models, HDETrack [ 54 ] and TSETrack [ 55 ] .
blocks.zh: 事件联系方法. 就我们所知,现有的基于事件的跟踪方法以在线方式运作,缺乏专门的多维分配方法。 为了证明我们的方法能够提高性能,我们把它与基于事件的三种普遍结合方法相比较: (1)卡尔曼滤镜(KF)与匈牙利算法(HA)[26,49,50,51],(2)邻居搜索(NS)[52,30,29,53],以及(3)基于IoU的匹配[32,33]. 除此之外,我们还与两个基于事件的单天体跟踪(SOT)模型HDETrack[54]和TSETrack[55]进行比较.

blocks.en:
Image-based association methods. Given the limited number of event-based association methods, we further compare our method with association modules from SOTA image-based MOT trackers.
It is important to note that these methods benefit from the one-to-one constraint and often utilize rich appearance features, while our method does not.
Despite these differences, we conduct a cross-modality comparison to thoroughly assess our tracking performance. This is done by substituting the association module in image-based trackers with our method. The comparative models are Permatrack [ 5 ] , UAVMOT [ 6 ] , OC-SORT [ 7 ] , LTTrack [ 9 ] , TOPIC [ 56 ] , along with a multi-dimensional assignment based model LPT [ 57 ] . Since OC-SORT is a purely motion-based method that effectively combines and improves upon KF+HA and IoU-based matching, we adopt it as the primary baseline on Ev-UAV, rather than comparing against its individual components.
All models are evaluated under their standard training and testing protocols, and no extra post-processing (such as filtering) is applied to ensure a fair comparison.
blocks.zh:
基于图像的关联方法. 鉴于基于事件的关联方法数量有限,我们进一步将我们的方法与来自SOTA图像的MOT跟踪器的关联模块进行比较.
必须指出,这些方法受益于一对一的制约,而且往往利用丰富的外观特征,而我们的方法却并非如此。
尽管存在这些差异,但我们进行了跨模式比较,以全面评估我们的跟踪业绩。 这是通过用我们的方法来取代基于图像的跟踪器中的关联模块来实现的. 比较模型有Permartrack [5],UAVMOT [6],OC-SORT [7],LTTRack [9],TOPIC [56],以及基于多维分配的LPT [57]. 由于OC-SORT是一种纯粹基于运动的方法,在KF+HA和IoU的匹配上有效结合和改进,因此我们采用它作为Ev-UAV上的首要基线,而不是与其单个组件进行比较.
所有模型都根据其标准培训和测试规程加以评价,不采用额外后处理(如过滤)来确保公平比较。

blocks.en:
Comparisons with event-based association methods. Experimental results of our method and event-based association methods under GT detections are presented in Table I .
Our method achieves the best tracking performance, attaining 98.5 MOTA and 95.7 IDF1 on the validation set and 98.4 MOTA and 95.3 IDF1 on the test set. It surpasses the second-best method by a significant margin (8% in MOTA and 50% in IDF1).
Though all methods are provided with GT detections, the reported F1 scores are not 1.0. We further analyze sequences with low F1. As visualized in Fig. 8 , some GT boxes contain very few or even zero events, making association infeasible. This leads to a reduction in true positives, which in turn lowers F1 and MOTA.

与事件关联方法的比较. GT检测下我们的方法和事件关联方法的实验结果见表一。
我们的方法实现了最佳的跟踪性能,在验证装置上达到98.5MOTA和95.7IDF1,在试验装置上达到98.4MOTA和95.3IDF1。 它大大超过了第二好的方法(MOTA占8%,以色列国防军1占50%)。
虽然所有方法都有GT检测,但报告的F1分数不是1.0分. 我们进一步分析低F1的序列. 如图8所示,一些GT框包含极少甚至零事件,使得关联不可行. 这导致真实阳性下降,进而降低F1和MOTA.

blocks.en:
Comparisons with image-based association methods. We compare our method against SOTA image-based MOT association models and event-based SOT models under five different detectors, three image-based and two event-based.
As reported in Table II , our method consistently outperforms association baselines under three detectors, Permatrack, UAVMOT, and RVT. Notably, under the event-based detector RVT, our HSG surpasses OC-SORT with notable tracking performance improvements, especially in MT ( > > 5%), ML ( > > 5%) and IDF1 ( > > 11%).
blocks.zh:
与图像关联方法的比较. 我们比较我们的方法与SOTA基于图像的MOT关联模型和基于事件的SOT模型在五个不同的探测器,三个基于图像和两个基于事件.
如表二所报告,我们的方法在Permarck、无人驾驶飞行器和RVT三个探测器之下的关联基线方面一直高于业绩。 值得注意的是,在基于事件的探测器RVT下,我们的HSG超过了OC-SORT,在跟踪性能方面有显著的改进,特别是在MT( > 5%)、ML( > 5%)和IDF1( > 11%)方面。

blocks.en:
When evaluated with the YOLOX detector [ 58 ] , HSG shows slightly lower MOTA (0.6%) and IDF1 (0.5%) than OC-SORT on the validation dataset but achieves a clear lead ( > > 3%) in the other three metrics. We attribute OC-SORT’s slight advantage in MOTA and IDF1 to OC-SORT’s filtering of fragmented tracklets, which reduces false positives in detections and identity switches. Within the same YOLOX setting, HSG also outperforms TOPIC by over 10% but falls slightly behind LTTrack (0.2%-1.4%).
When sharing the same detection results as TSETrack, our method consistently outperforms other methods such as OC-SORT and LPT, but shows a marginal performance drop of 0.9% compared to TSETrack on the validation set. It is worth noting that the narrow margins against both LTTrack and TSETrack are within expectations. Given that our method operates without the one-to-one matching constraint, is completely training-free, and relies solely on kinematic cues, these minor performance drops represent a highly reasonable trade-off. Collectively, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in event-based association.
blocks.zh:
在使用YOLOX探测器[58]进行评价时,HSG在验证数据集上显示的MOTA(0.6%)和IDF1(0.5%)略低于OC-SORT,但在其他三个度量衡中却取得了明显的领先( > 3%). 我们把OC-SORT在MOTA和IDF1中的微弱优势归因于OC-SORT对分散的轨道进行过滤,从而减少检测和身份开关中的假阳性. 在同一YOLOX环境下,HSG也比TOPIC高出10%以上,但略低于LTTRack(0.2%-1.4%)。
当分享与 TSETrack 相同的检测结果时,我们的方法一贯比其他方法,如 OC- SORT 和 LPT ,但比 TSETrack 显示在验证集上的边际性能下降0.9%. 值得注意的是,与LTTRack和TSETrack相对的狭窄的边距是预期之内的。 鉴于我们的方法在操作时没有一对一的匹配约束,完全没有训练,并且完全依靠运动提示,这些小的性能下降代表着高度合理的权衡. 这些成果集体表明,我们在基于事件的联系方面的做法是有效的。

In case (b), some pedestrian detections are also missing in frames 344 and 346. Our method successfully associates fragmented tracklets in both scenarios, while OC-SORT fails and drops them due to insufficient tracking hits over time.

blocks.en: As Ev-UAV is a detection benchmark, the originally provided tracking labels contain some inaccuracies, we corrected and refined the tracking labels on test and validation sets. This was done by manually comparing UAV motion patterns in 2D plane and 3D space to ensure reliable tracking annotations, as illustrated in Fig. 11 . More tracking label correction details please refer to the supplementary material, and the corrected dataset will be published in the future 1 1 1 https://github.com/zhazhabiu/HSG-Event-based-Association . The total number of sequences in test and validation sets is 48. Among these, 20 sequences were refined, including 14 in the test set and 6 in the validation set. To ensure transparency, we report evaluation results both on the remaining 28 unmodified sequences and on the full set with corrected sequences in Table III . The rectified dataset with updated tracking annotations will be made publicly available in our repository.

blocks.en: The upstream detector is EV-SpSegNet [ 14 ] , a segmentation network that extracts object events from raw event data. blocks.en: As shown in Table III , our approach outperforms OC-SORT by over 2 × \times across all metrics on both original and corrected Ev-UAV. Additional experiments with varying region growing radius r r are provided in the supplementary material. blocks.en: The Ev-UAV dataset presents a classic and challenging tiny object tracking scenario. Different from image-based small object tracking, events here offer no appearance cues and the association problem is further complicated by its many-to-many nature. Despite these challenges, our method demonstrates robust and accurate associations, reliably linking isolated tracklets and effectively addressing the inherent difficulties of tiny object tracking.
blocks.zh: Ev-UAV数据集呈现出经典且具有挑战性的微小物体跟踪情景. 与基于图像的小型物体跟踪不同,这里的事件没有出现提示,关联问题因其多对多的性质而变得更加复杂. 尽管存在这些挑战,我们的方法显示出有力和准确的联系,可靠地连接了孤立的轨道,有效地解决了小物体跟踪的固有困难。

blocks.en: Although multi-dimensional assignment sacrifices some computational efficiency for accuracy gains, we rigorously analyze the time complexity of our proposed method. Our method consists of two stages, graph modeling and graph partitioning. Let 𝒩 \mathcal{N} denote the number of tracklets to be associated, and ζ \zeta ( ζ ≪ 𝒩 \zeta\ll\mathcal{N} ) denote the candidates of each tracklet after initial sparsification. In the modeling stage, metric calculations operate in O ⁡ ( 𝒩 2 ) O(\mathcal{N}^{2}) , and K-means with I I iterations and N + 1 N+1 centers operates in O ⁡ ( 𝒩 ⋅ I ⋅ ζ ⋅ ( N + 1 ) ) O(\mathcal{N}\cdot I\cdot\zeta\cdot(N+1)) . Consequently, the whole time complexity of modeling is O ⁡ ( 𝒩 ⋅ ζ + 𝒩 2 ) O(\mathcal{N}\cdot\zeta+\mathcal{N}^{2}) , which is dominated by O ⁡ ( 𝒩 2 ) O(\mathcal{N}^{2}) since our implementation is in serial. After modeling, the HSG consists of 𝒩 \mathcal{N} nodes and E ≈ ( 𝒩 ⋅ ζ ) / 2 E\approx\nicefrac{{(\mathcal{N}\cdot\zeta)}}{{2}} edges. In the first partitioning iteration, computing the connectivity similarity for all vertices costs O ⁡ ( 𝒩 ⋅ ζ 2 ) O(\mathcal{N}\cdot\zeta^{2}) . Since merging costs O ⁡ ( E ) O(E) which is negligible compared to O ⁡ ( 𝒩 ⋅ ζ 2 ) O(\mathcal{N}\cdot\zeta^{2}) , the time complexity of a single search-merge is O ⁡ ( 𝒩 ⋅ ζ 2 ) O(\mathcal{N}\cdot\zeta^{2}) . Each iteration reduces the number of vertices by at least half, so partitioning requires at most O ⁡ ( log 2 ⁡ 𝒩 ) O(\log_{2}\mathcal{N}) iterations. The time complexity of the whole graph partitioning is O ⁡ ( 𝒩 ⋅ ζ 2 ⋅ log 2 ⁡ 𝒩 ) O(\mathcal{N}\cdot\zeta^{2}\cdot\log_{2}\mathcal{N}) . Therefore, the overall time complexity of our method is O ⁡ ( 𝒩 2 + 𝒩 ⋅ ζ 2 ⋅ log 2 ⁡ 𝒩 ) O(\mathcal{N}^{2}+\mathcal{N}\cdot\zeta^{2}\cdot\log_{2}\mathcal{N}) .

blocks.en: Beyond qualitative analysis, we quantitatively evaluate the computational efficiency of our method against some association methods in Table IV . Since comparisons are frame-based whereas our method is event-driven, we report two metrics, frames per second (FPS) and events per second (EPS). All evaluations are conducted on a platform equipped with an Intel i7-7800X CPU @3.50GHz and an NVIDIA RTX4090 GPU. The fastest method is OC-SORT. It achieves a significantly higher speed (over 10 × \times faster) than the others. Although our method is slower than LPT, the other global optimization assignment method, it still processes over 1M EPS and requires no GPU resources. Given that the modeling stage with O ⁡ ( 𝒩 2 ) O(\mathcal{N}^{2}) is the primary computational bottleneck, our method presents potential for further acceleration via parallelization.

blocks.en: Our ablation studies focus on two modeling terms of our fuzzy modeling pipeline and the adaptive threshold τ \tau in the graph partitioning. Experimental settings remain identical to before. Ablation results on modeling terms are presented in Table V and Table VI . Besides, we conduct a quantitative analysis of the Bézier curve order, comparing linear, quadratic, and cubic fitting, as shown in Table VII and Table VIII .

blocks.en:
(1) Analysis of Bézier curve-based position smoothness .
On eTram, the improvement brought by the Bézier curve-based position smoothness is modest, as object motion is predominantly linear, making the line-based error metric the primary distinguishing factor. In contrast, on Ev-UAV, where tracklets undergo large spatio-temporal variations, the Bézier curve model becomes the preferred choice. On the original set, the performance of our method is lower than that of the variant without ➀. This occurs because the incorrect GT tracking labels divide an object trajectory into a few segments, further penalizing our metrics as one predicted trajectory can only match one GT trajectory. However, on the corrected set, our method yields nearly 2 × \times improvements over the variant without this term, clearly demonstrating its effectiveness in handling complex motion patterns and long-range association.
blocks.zh:
(1)基于贝塞尔曲线位置光滑度的分析.
在eTram上,贝塞尔曲线基位平滑带来的改进是适度的,因为物体运动主要是线性运动,使得线性误差度量成为主要区别因素. 相比之下,在Ev-UAV上,轨迹会发生巨大的时空变异,贝塞尔曲线模型成为首选. 在原集上,我们方法的性能低于没有QQ的变体. 这是因为不正确的GT跟踪标签将一个物体的轨迹分成几个段,进一步惩罚我们的度量衡,因为一个预测的轨迹只能匹配一个GT轨迹. 然而,在经过修正的组合上,我们的方法比变体有近2×%的改进,而没有这一术语,这清楚地表明它在处理复杂运动模式和远距离结合方面的效力。

Fig. 14 compares our adaptive threshold τ \tau against a series of fixed thresholds ranging from 0.1 to 0.9. The performance using τ \tau is represented by horizontal dashed lines. Table X and Table XI report the performance of our method without γ \gamma or the denominator m + 1 m+1 from the τ \tau calculation. On eTram, our full method consistently outperforms these variants. In contrast to this, two variants perform on par with or even better than our full method on Ev-UAV. We attribute this to the differing graph sparsity across datasets. Specifically, γ \gamma and m + 1 m+1 correction are designed for dense graphs, addressing size imbalance and overly strict merging conditions, respectively. When the HSG is sparse, the connectivity within a vertex degenerates into a path, and their effect diminishes or even introduces few incorrect associations. These results confirm that adapting the method’s configuration to the target scenario can improve performance across different applications.

blocks.en: V-G Discussion
blocks.zh: V-G 讨论

blocks.en: Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our method. However, our approach still possesses certain limitations. Fundamentally, our graph partitioning is akin to a voting system, assigning each tracklet to the most likely trajectory without enforcing global continuity within a partition. This can lead to erroneous associations when voting evidence is insufficient or ambiguous. For example, under sparse evidence, an isolated tracklet may be incorrectly absorbed into a continuous trajectory merely due to spatial proximity and a similar motion direction. Conversely, when evidence is ambiguous, such as in extremely dense crowds, the limitation becomes equally pronounced. In such scenarios, event trajectories of adjacent targets heavily overlap and exhibit similar motion patterns, introducing severe ambiguity into the voting mechanism. Addressing these limitations opens up several future directions, including examining a sliding window of tracklets within each partition after each round of graph partitioning, or designing incremental metrics that capture motion continuity across multiple tracklets.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we formulate the event-based multi-dimensional assignment problem as a graph partition task. Unlike image-based tracking, event-based tracking inherently involves the many-to-many association, which is an underdetermined and NP-hard task arising from the asynchronous nature of events. Therefore, we propose a fuzzy modeling method to construct a Hierarchical Sparse Graph (HSG) that captures relationships between candidate pairs. Subsequently, an automatic graph partitioning algorithm is also developed based on the HSG to obtain optimal assignments. The overall method is training-free and plug-and-play.
Experiments on both one-to-one and many-to-many matching scenarios show the strong performance of our method across diverse challenging conditions, particularly in long-range and tiny object tracking.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们将基于事件的多维分配问题发展成一个图表分区任务. 与基于图像的跟踪不同,基于事件的跟踪本质上涉及多对多关联,这是事件同步性质引起的一个未确定和NP难的任务. 因此,我们建议采用模糊的建模方法,以构建一个能捕捉候选对子之间关系的等级模型。 随后,还根据HSG开发了自动图分割算法,以获得最佳任务. 整体方法是训练无阻和插座与游戏.
对一对一和多对多种匹配情景的实验表明,我们的方法在各种具有挑战性的条件下,特别是在远距离和微小的物体跟踪方面,表现很强。
